remarks: This Nicely renovated, charming ranch has all the amenities for today's standards. From the moment you walk-in you are welcome to a lovely kitchen/family, fireplace and all hardwood floors. The kitchen offers white cabinets, dark granite counter tops all with stainless steel appliances. Also included on the main level are two bedrooms. The master bedroom has a large shower with his/her's double sinks. A good size closet as well. The second bedroom shares the bathroom outside of the hallway. Freshly painted throughout with vaulted ceilings in the family room. The Lower level offers a finished family room with 1 bedroom and 1.5 bath, laundry area, storage. In addition a large deck off the kitchen and good size 1 car garage.
